item: A TRUNCATE that answers busy with no frame counts is not called a reader's pin, and the card audit's size estimate pauses with the card audit
summary: The read of the final head (L1, L2). The guard's PASSIVE no longer runs inside the gate, so it can meet another checkpointer, and SQLite answers (1, -1, -1) then (reproduced with a TRUNCATE waiting on an old reader): the pin note said the figures were not those of a log in WAL mode, and busy == 1 read as a reader holding the log. busy with no frame counts is now its own sentence in the pin report (checkpoint-busy), the drain record says another_checkpoint, the log line says another checkpoint held the lock, and no pin report is built for it; busy 0 with no counts stays the non-WAL case. card-audit-preflight runs the same producer pass as card-audit (estimate_card_audit calls observe_producers) and is on PAUSED_WHILE_WAL_PINNED. The follow-on's test file for the pause is tests/test_heavy_paused_wal.py: tests/test_heavy_paused.py is already #1422's. Real-SQLite test, the drain-level pair and the non-WAL twin; six mutants killed.
